Head of Customer Success

Salary:
£42,000 – £45,000 + variable (15% of base OTE)

About WorkBuzz

WorkBuzz was founded in 2018, has raised £12.5m funding and has 400 clients, including iconic brands like Five Guys, Butlins and Virgin. Our mission is to lead a new era of employee listening: AI-first, beyond surveys and turning employee voice into competitive advantage.

Our AI-powered platform makes it easy for mid and large-sized companies to gather real-time employee feedback and uncover what truly matters. Our new AI-native product Dialogue launches us into operational listening, putting employee listening in the hands of operational leaders – where decisions are made and change actually happens.

Trusted across industries, we combine smart technology with a human approach - helping leaders make better decisions, faster. We’re growing fast and looking for mission-driven people to join us!

_________________________________________________________________

The Role

We believe that great client experiences are the foundation of long‑term success. As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll own a portfolio of mid-market accounts (broadly £15k–£25k ARR) end to end, from onboarding through to renewal. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, helping clients get real value from WorkBuzz, from initial onboarding through to ongoing adoption. This is an individual contributor CSM role, so you’ll take on more complex mid-market accounts, work with greater independence and contribute to how the wider Client Success team operates, including mentoring newer colleagues.

The role carries commercial accountability across NPS, health score, NRR and upsell, alongside responsibility for client relationships and delivery. You’ll be expected to spot churn risks and expansion opportunities early and take action before you’re asked.

_________________________________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio ownership — Growing and retaining a portfolio of mid-market clients, including some of our larger and more complex mid-tier accounts.
Relationship management — Building excellent relationships, becoming a trusted advisor and helping clients use platform features and best practice to meet their goals.
Onboarding — Setting up WorkBuzz for new customers based on their unique challenges and goals.
Training & enablement — Helping clients launch their own surveys and get maximum value from the platform.
EBRs and insight reviews — Leading Quarterly Business Reviews independently, translating data into clear, practical recommendations.
Risk & opportunity monitoring — Spotting churn risk or expansion opportunity early and acting on it.
Journey and playbook improvement — Contributing ideas that shape how the whole Client Success team works, not just how you work.
Peer mentoring — Supporting the development of newer Client Success Executives.
Cross-functional collaboration — Working with Product and CX to feed client insight into wider decisions.
Data & CRM — Keeping customer success metrics and records accurate and current in Planhat.
Commercial performance — Delivering against KPIs including NPS, Customer Health, Net Revenue Retention and upsell pipeline contribution.
Flexibility — Occasional out-of-hours support, and travel to client visits and events.

What this role is really like

This is not a light-touch or purely relationship-focused role. The executional elements, including accurate CRM records, well-run onboarding and sharp EBR preparation, are a core part of delivering strong client outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail and a genuine interest in building deep platform knowledge, alongside the confidence to work with senior client stakeholders. It’s a genuinely fast-paced role that requires adaptability as the business continues to grow and evolve.

_________________________________________________________________

Requirements For The Role

3+ years' experience managing mid-market SaaS clients through a full client lifecycle
A track record of retention and growth impact within a portfolio, with a good eye for commercial detail
Confidence communicating and influencing at senior levels, including with client decision-makers
Ability to lead client relationships independently, including more complex accounts within your portfolio
Experience contributing to Client Success improvement initiatives, and appetite to do more of this
Comfortable interpreting data for clients and translating it into clear, practical recommendations
Strong technical aptitude — comfortable with platform admin, troubleshooting and process detail
A growth mindset — you look for ways to improve how the team works, not just how you work
Commercially aware, with the ability to recognise risk and opportunity before it's flagged by someone else
Tech savvy, utilising AI tools for productivity and effectiveness in-role
Able to adapt quickly in a changing environment
Willing to travel for client meetings and events, with occasional out-of-hours support where required

_________________________________________________________________

Our culture is built on our values and the behaviours that bring them to life.

We seek people who chime with our values and demonstrate, in their own way, behaviours that bring them to life. We’re not looking for one “type” of person - we value individuality and diversity. What matters most is that candidates demonstrate behaviours that support success in-role and make our culture thrive.

Aspire Higher - We set BIG goals, embrace growth and challenge limits. Reaching for new possibilities, we are curious and continuously learning, if there’s a better way, we’ll find it.

Energised by Challenge- We never stand still! We approach challenges with energy and resilience. We thrive on the tough stuff, embracing change as a constant.

Trust in Action- We build trust through our expertise and through consistent, high-quality delivery. With transparency, reliability and authenticity at our core, we act with integrity and do what we say, delivering on our promises.

Win Together- We are fuelled by collaboration. We elevate each other, our clients and our partners showing up in meaningful ways. Sharing in success, we celebrate every victory- big or small.

Why you’ll love working at WorkBuzz

Our culture – WorkBuzz is fast-paced, dynamic and rewarding. Everyone has a voice and the smartest idea wins.
Clear purpose – be part of building something which matters.
Be the best you can be – we will invest in your development and help you grow.

The role.

Respond to client security questionnaires, due diligence requests, and audit inquiries; maintain the reusable answer library so responses get faster and more consistent over time.

Operationalize the data retention and disposal policy: track department retention schedules, document exceptions and legal holds, and verify retention settings across platforms with IT.
Support the privacy program including data mapping, data subject request handling, and GDPR and CCPA obligation tracking.
Draft and maintain compliance policies, SOPs, and process documentation; keep them current, published (for internal use where applicable) and actually followed.
Prepare risk and compliance status reporting for leadership.
Participate in business continuity and disaster recovery planning and tabletop exercises.
Participate in security incident response management.
Maintain and monitor risk register and prepare for annual risk assessment.
Administer security awareness training and track compliance.
Support internal audits, access reviews, and periodic control testing.

Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent practical experience.

Hands-on experience reading and reviewing commercial contracts, ideally MSAs, DPAs, or security addenda, and working with legal counsel on redlines.

Working knowledge of at least one major compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF) and what evidence looks like in practice.

Clear, concise written communication; you can summarize a 40-page contract into the three things that matter.
Comfortable working with SaaS tools and learning new platforms quickly; you like using software to make process better.
